items.prompt:
"Create an ultra-realistic full-body fashion character reference image of the same adult woman(match face) shown twice side-by-side against a dark charcoal studio background: one front view and one back view.

Appearance: Long straight deep-red hair with smooth natural strands, full bangs, and a red headband. Soft doll-like makeup, rosy cheeks, subtle pink lips, and bright green eyes.

Outfit: Pink short-sleeve fitted T-shirt under white denim short overalls. The overalls have red heart patches throughout, heart-shaped details on the bib and straps, rolled cuffs, and red metallic accents. She wears mismatched knee-high socks—one white with red stripes and a heart, the other red with a repeating heart pattern—and white, brown, and red high-top sneakers with heart details. A red heart choker and delicate necklace complete the outfit.

Front pose: Slightly tilted head, one leg crossed and lifted behind her, arms relaxed at her sides, gentle playful expression.

Back pose: Standing naturally with her back toward the camera, showing the long red hair, overall straps, rear pockets, heart details, and matching socks and sneakers.

Style: Clean studio character reference photography, realistic fabric and hair texture, soft even lighting, full-body framing, consistent proportions and identical outfit across both views.

9:16ar"
items.title: 调皮表情美妆人像
